study.title: ABCB-mediated shootward auxin transport feeds into the root clock

purpose: Source access, worksheet schema and biological-unit audit for E79/E80. No new effect estimates, P values or confidence intervals are contained here.
known_outcomes_before_registration: The original paper reports lower DR5:LUC amplitude and no detected period change after ABCB perturbation. Published figures and tests were visible during source inspection.

clock_methods.measurement: Fiji analog digital units per pixel in a square region at a future prebranch site, covering the preceding OZ oscillation.
clock_methods.amplitude_definition: Highest minus lowest DR5:LUC signal in the OZ region.
clock_methods.period_definition: Time spacing between DR5:LUC maxima, determined from image frames.
clock_methods.unit_interpretation: Retain the published unit. It is not a measured IAA concentration or a molecular transport rate; do not infer derivative units from the label.
clock_methods.independence: Unknown; multiple period intervals per root are a possible explanation of the counts, not an established assignment.
clock_methods.methods_crossreference_discrepancy: Methods cite Appendix S7B/C for extraction, while the accessible Appendix illustrates the clock trace and amplitude in S4D-F.

visual_verification.result: Fig2 I/J and Fig6 G/H axis labels match period/amplitude source columns. Caption n values differ from numeric observation counts. Point density visually agrees with more period observations than amplitude observations, without identifying roots.

inference_limits: Do not treat all clock rows as independent roots, pair adjacent period/amplitude rows, infer batch membership or fill missing amplitudes to match captions.
Fig4C cell values are nested in seedlings whose identities are not provided; do not reconstruct clusters by assuming every ten consecutive rows are one seedling.
Fig4A pools, age and precise endpoint timing are not specified in Chen et al.; referenced-protocol defaults are not confirmed Chen assay parameters.
Global amiR and outer-tissue syn-tasi are mechanistically related interventions in one paper, not independent laboratories or a second experiment on the identical root cohort.
Morphology at five days and root length at ten days do not independently identify cell production at the three-day clock measurement.
Distal LRC cell length is not mature cortex cell length; meristem length and cell counts are not division rates.
Directional shootward transport plus altered reporter amplitude does not directly establish a full reflux cycle, a cycle time or a same-molecule return.
